protocol_rules.RECIST-PD-IMPRESSION: Dual-audited final impression explicitly concludes progression, recurrence, or worsening.
protocol_rules.RECIST-PD-NEW-LESION: New oncologic lesion or new metastatic disease documented (RECIST 1.1: new lesion defines progressive disease).
protocol_rules.RECIST-PD-QUANTITATIVE: Paired lesion measurements meet RECIST-informed progression threshold (>=20% and >=5 mm increase).
protocol_rules.RECIST-PD-QUANTITATIVE-SUPPORT: Report-level supportive measurement signal; not a full RECIST sum-of-diameters assessment.
protocol_rules.RECIST-PD-DIRECTIONAL: Findings document explicit comparative worsening language (e.g., 较前增大/增多).
protocol_rules.RECIST-PR-IMPRESSION: Dual-audited final impression explicitly concludes improvement, response, or regression.
protocol_rules.RECIST-PR-QUANTITATIVE: Paired lesion measurements meet RECIST-informed regression threshold (>=30% decrease).
protocol_rules.RECIST-PR-DIRECTIONAL: Findings document explicit comparative improvement language (e.g., 较前缩小/吸收).
protocol_rules.RECIST-SD-IMPRESSION: Dual-audited final impression explicitly concludes no meaningful change.
protocol_rules.RECIST-SD-DIRECTIONAL: Findings explicitly document no meaningful change or explicitly negated progression.
protocol_rules.RECIST-MIXED-IMPRESSION: Dual-audited final impression documents concurrent worsening and improvement.
protocol_rules.RECIST-MIXED-DIRECTIONAL: Findings document concurrent worsening and improvement across disease sites.
protocol_rules.MEASUREMENT-BELOW-RECIST-INFORMED-THRESH: Paired measurements extracted but change does not meet RECIST-informed thresholds.
protocol_rules.QUALITY-EXPLICIT-COMPARISON: Primary labels require explicit comparison language in findings or impression.
protocol_rules.QUALITY-IMPRESSION-PRIORITY: The dual-audited impression is the primary synthesis; explicit disease-relevant conflict with a stable impression is quarantined as indeterminate.
protocol_rules.QUALITY-IMPRESSION-SUPPORTED: Primary labels are supported by the dual-audited final impression.
protocol_rules.QUALITY-UNCERTAINTY-DOWNGRADE: Hedged or equivocal statements (iRECIST: not unequivocal) are downgraded out of the primary set.
protocol_rules.QUALITY-POSTOP-INFLAMMATORY-FLAG: Postoperative or inflammatory co-text downgrades findings-level progression evidence.
protocol_rules.QUALITY-ONCOLOGIC-SCOPE: Progression/regression evidence must refer to malignant disease burden, not a non-oncologic complication.
protocol_rules.QUALITY-NONONCOLOGIC-DOWNGRADE: Effusion, pneumothorax, atelectasis, infection, fibrosis, and postoperative change are not tumor progression endpoints.
protocol_rules.QUALITY-CONSISTENCY-MET-PROGRESSION: New metastatic disease must be labeled progression or mixed, never stable or regression.
protocol_rules.QUALITY-INDETERMINATE-CONFLICT: Definitive new-metastasis evidence conflicts with a stable impression conclusion.
